snippet.title: Super Frozen World 2 [NSMBU] | Release Trailer❄️
snippet.description:
Super Frozen World 2 [NSMBU] | Release Trailer

☃️Download the mod HERE☃️
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Wo3kiitLHluKlmaDgZsplPZzm_Jb-w6A?usp=sharing

☃️About the Mod☃️

Contents of the mod: 

• Two Worlds
• Custom Code [Tsuru / Kusa]
• Custom Backgrounds
• Custom Tilesets
• Custom Music
• small visual changes
• Custom Toad houses
• Redesignd Ambush rushes
•German Translation
•Custom Overworld

Super Frozen World 2 is the sequel to Super Frozen World and features two worlds with a completely new look! Filled with snowy level themes, gimmicks, and mechanics from the original game. Have Fun!❄️
